mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT am.link_id) AS nums, am.severity AS severity, am.type AS type FROM alert_message am WHERE am.state = 1 GROUP BY am.type,am.severity
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM project WHERE id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT am.link_id FROM alert_message am WHERE am.type = 1 AND am.state = 1 )
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM module WHERE id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT am.link_id FROM alert_message am WHERE am.type = 2 AND am.state = 1 )
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM asset WHERE id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT am.link_id FROM alert_message am WHERE am.type = 3 AND am.state = 1 )
SELECT COUNT(am.id) AS nmus,am.type,am.link_id AS linkId FROM alert_message am WHERE am.state = 1 GROUP BY am.type,am.link_id ORDER BY nmus DESC,type limit #{topN}

SELECT ar.alert_name AS alertName,ar.severity AS level, COUNT(am.rule_id) AS nums FROM alert_rule ar LEFT JOIN alert_message am ON ar.id = am.rule_id WHERE am.state = 1 GROUP BY am.rule_id ORDER BY nums DESC limit #{topN}

SELECT am.id,am.type,am.link_id AS linkId,am.rule_id AS ruleId,am.severity AS level,am.summary,am.start_at AS time FROM alert_message am WHERE am.state = 1 ORDER BY field( am.severity,'high','medium','low'), am.type limit #{pageNo},#{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN ar.severity = 'high' THEN 0 END) AS high, COUNT(CASE WHEN ar.severity = 'medium' THEN 0 END) AS medium, COUNT(CASE WHEN ar.severity = 'low' THEN 0 END) AS low FROM alert_rule ar

SELECT ps.idc_id AS idcId, COUNT(CASE WHEN ps.status = '1' THEN 0 END) AS prometheusServerActive, COUNT(CASE WHEN ps.status = '0' THEN 0 END) AS prometheusServerInactive FROM prom_server ps GROUP BY ps.idc_id
SELECT ass.idc_id AS idcId, GROUP_CONCAT(en.id) AS endpointIds FROM endpoint en LEFT JOIN asset ass ON en.asset_id = ass.id GROUP BY ass.idc_id
